lines_described: Round the border one line of late inscription.
first: (1)wos : (2)soreyi mol(3)nbeteeeqowi : srkede : (4)tedḫelowi : esloye : terike(5)lowi : at mẖe : psoẖ?ek?ete : a(6)t mẖe : psḫ(7)rkete[.]

rendering: O Wêsh! O Ashêri! Qenabelile (or the honourable? Nabelile): born of Kharakalabal : begotten of Lakhalêye. (Formulae A B.)

changes.why: the group after w o is the same 4+3 group that Griffith transliterates ši in pšiḫ (Faras 31, p. 648); read s + i
Qenabelile: the 7-shaped sign with the slash before it is q (/3), the small S is e; the crossed 4 + hook is l i; the S signs are l and e (Griffith: e and l very similar)
Kharakalabal: first 3 is ẖ, the long-tailed sign k, the S signs l, the check-mark sign b
Lakhalêye: first S is l, the 3 is ẖ
closer look: the raised 5 stands over the e, not over the l
closer look: the second sign of the first formula is ب with a dot below (to), formula A

kept.why: copy clearly has 4 (i) after the s, as in all six texts of this pack; Griffith's English name does not show the ending
the copy has q o w i before the divider; Griffith leaves it out of the rendering

unsure.could_be: the 3 with a long crossing stroke could be q or m; the small 2-like sign could be l
unsure.why: same sequence in Faras 35 (pso + crossed 3 + S + long-tailed sign + e te); not named in his notes
the raised 5 stands between l and e

notes: Altar border text copied in three rows, each read right to left across both halves; the wide gap in the middle of each row is not a break in the text. Formula A (ato mẖe ...) then B (at mẖe ...). The hatching at the left end of row 3 is about one sign.

object: Imperfect altar of rough workmanship, the whole side to the right of the spout broken away, l. 42 centimers including spout.

A small tick mark above the row between psi and the hatched ẖ in line 9 is not a sign. The divider inside psiḫ : rkete is clearly in the copy (Griffith comments on it).

notes: One line round the border, copied in three rows read right to left; row 3 (line 7) stands under the right end of row 2 and ends with [p]soḫr (the end of formula B is not copied). Griffith's order in the rendering (takite of y...khamek tamite in Pakharas) differs from the order of the words on the stone (y..ẖmk : tki-te : pẖrse te.. : tmite-lowi). Formula B uses mlo for mẖe (p. 648).
